notes.drag: carriage drag: none until a source gives one
notes.generation: 5 is ours (newer than the 48N6E2's 4, which holds section 4630); weapons.ibx's table stops at 4 (from 1995); a SAM's generation keys only its weapons.ibx section
notes.kg: open: no weight published; the Buk-M2's 9M317 (715 kg), which the system is compared with, held
notes.power: one hit destroys a fighter (inferred, as the AIM-9M)
notes.blast_m: open: no warhead weight published; the lethal radius is open; held by blast scaling (inferred): the AIM-9A / B's 9 m (ds-aim9) for its 4.5 kg warhead (docs/real-weapons.md §1.4) times the cube root of this warhead's mass ratio with the 9M317's 70 kg warhead held
notes.range_km: Ta'er-2B 50–105 km: inferred 50 km the Ta'er-2's range (Taer 2 article: 50 km), 105 km the 2B's
notes.ceiling_m: 25–30 km: the top (the Taer 2 article gives 25–27 km)
notes.mach: open: no speed published; the 9M317's Mach 4 held (threats.md §2)
notes.motion._absAcceleration: 120 m/s², the AIM-9M record's (inferred: no burn time published)
notes.motion._spiralAccelBeta: top speed a / beta: 120 / the held Mach 4
notes.motion.burn: the burn with which the missile's launch zone from rest (combat.gd fires from the unit's pose at speed 0; missile.rs dlz with "burn": the distance travelled in burn + 4 s) is its published range
notes.motion._timeAcceleration: the burn, so the original's reading of the section flies as long
notes.motion._timeConstOrientation: flies straight 0.5 s after launch (the AIM-9M record's)
notes.motion._fireReleaseInterval: open: the reader's default 0.5 s (combat.gd); one missile in the air at a time (docs/ai.md §14)
